## Focus Areas

- PROJECTS: construction, interiors, fit-out, space design, public sector contracts, material sourcing.
- TECHNOLOGY & SOLUTIONS: enterprise software, SaaS platforms, digital products, B2B consulting, cloud architecture.
- AMARIS: creative direction, brand strategy, production, digital experiences, editorial systems.
- VENTURES: consumer brands, proprietary products, new ventures, strategic investments, incubation.

## Location

Temara, Morocco. Serving Morocco, North Africa, and international partners.
